title: Decision Model Factory: Building Specialized Sovereign Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision needs vary with each application, language, and deployment environment. The Decision Model Factory turns those needs into specialized, sovereign models on demand. A brief recipe guides the training, calibration, verification, and evaluation of a selected backbone, delivering a deployable decision model under the operator's control. The same workflow creates a new specialist whenever the requirements change. Across Japanese decision tasks, compact deployment, and long-context passage ranking, five factory-built models improve upon their backbones; three surpass the strongest results in a fixed public Japanese benchmark comparison. A dedicated runner computes only permitted-answer probabilities and reuses shared context, more than doubling serving speed on matched multi-question workloads with essentially unchanged decision scores. Together, the factory and runner make fast, task-specific decision models practical to build and dep

translated_title: 决策模型工厂：构建专业化主权决策模型
translated_abstract: 决策需求因应用、语言和部署环境而各不相同。决策模型工厂（Decision Model Factory）能够按需将这些需求转化为专业化、主权可控的模型。一套简明的配方指导对选定骨干模型进行训练、校准、验证和评估，从而在操作者的掌控下交付一个可部署的决策模型。当需求发生变化时，同一工作流程即可创建新的专用模型。在日语决策任务、紧凑部署和长文本段落排序等场景中，五个由工厂构建的模型均优于其骨干模型；其中三个模型在固定的公开日语基准测试比较中超越了最强结果。一个专用的运行器仅计算允许答案的概率并复用共享上下文，在匹配的多问题工作负载上将服务速度提升一倍以上，而决策分数基本保持不变。总之，该工厂与运行器相结合，使快速构建和部署特定任务的决策模型成为现实。
tldr: 提出决策模型工厂，可按需将骨干模型转化为专业化、主权可控的决策模型，配合专用运行器在保持决策分数基本不变的情况下将服务速度提升一倍以上。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Decision Model Factory that on-demand turns backbone models into specialized, sovereign decision models, with a dedicated runner that more than doubles serving speed while keeping decision scores essentially unchanged.
